Such a great game!  It's a lovingly crafted 3rd person shoot 'em / bash 'em up. As a space marine with a bolter and chainsword, you really feel like a one man army.  The combat is the star of the show with this title.  It's very satisfying to mow down a horde of orcs with your bolter and then dive into the fight with your chainsword to finish them off.

The multiplayer is "good", but it gets old very fast.  It would be much better if there were more content and greater variety of modes.

Space Marines is great if you like killing stuff and of course... Warhammer! ^^ 

The Campaign is short but keeps you entertained. Be sure to grab it during a sale.

Just keep in mind, the multiplayer is dead. The Lobby-System is aweful as well. I thought that I find more players in the DLC content but that is not the case. Dont bother buying them (Chaos Unleashed and Dreadnought).

Hack and slash fun. If you enjoy the 40k universe in anyway, Buy this game. Even though its just your standard hack and slash gameplay, the story line is great and the Multiplayer is great too. Im telling you Any 40k fan will really appreciate this. 

 I really hope there will be a WH40K Space Marine 2, maybe with some more playable chapters/Races and wargear for multiplayer. But if not,  id buy the game anyway, just cause this game was so "bloody" good. ----> BUY IT.
